messages:
priya: quick fyi — onboarding sample app is blocked: it calls an admin API to enumerate a customer's private models but the Python SDK client doesn't expose that surface. curl works fine. anyone seen this?

sam: which route? `/v1/admin/models/list`? i thought admin surfaces would be in a separate AdminClient; maybe the py package never shipped it. paste the error?

priya: error was:
```
AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'list_models_admin'
```
I did `from redwood import Client; c = Client(token=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']); c.list_models_admin()` — curl with same token returns 200 and payload.

elaine: bleh, that's a painful hit for first-run DX. short-term fix: doc the REST fallback + tiny requests snippet for quickstart. long-term: add a minimal AdminClient to py (list/get/update) and harmonize retry/auth semantics across SDKs.

sam: also callout: node SDK auto-retries certain idempotent POSTs on 5xx/429; python currently doesn't. in a recent demo the frontend retried after a 502 and python surfaced the error, which resulted in duplicate token consumption in the demo flow. customer-facing friction + cost.

priya: was node sending Idempotency-Key? we saw double billing on a demo account and panicked.

sam: node will attach `Idempotency-Key` when callers set it; additionally, node has an internal heuristic that will retry safe POSTs. python currently only retries on low-level network errors via requests. so failure semantics differ.

elaine: proposed plan: (1) add REST fallback snippet to quickstart docs with clear note that admin ops are temporarily only available via REST for py; (2) open py-sdk PR that adds AdminClient (list/get/update minimal surface) and introduces a configurable retry policy that defaults to avoiding silent duplicate attempts for non-idempotent calls; (3) add auth-scope/unit tests and a tiny CI e2e that hits the admin list via REST so quickstart CI fails fast if API changes.

priya: can someone paste the temporary workaround snippet so i can unblock CI?

sam: workaround (python requests):
```
import os, requests
r = requests.get(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/models/list',
  headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']}"}
)
print(r.json())
```
For streaming generation parity, use `stream=True` and iterate over `r.iter_lines()` to approximate REST streaming chunks.

elaine: i'll file the GH issue and attach a minimal repro and suggested unit tests. i'll also include a test asserting we don't auto-retry non-idempotent POSTs without explicit idempotency keys.

devex-bot: Created issue #612: "py-sdk: AdminClient and retry parity with node (blocking quickstart)" label devex/priority-medium. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/612

sam: nice. follow-up: when we implement AdminClient, let's ensure the auth scope required is identical to the REST doc so users don't run into 403s when switching from curl to SDK. also add a tiny example in the quickstart showing how to set Idempotency-Key for generation calls.

priya: added to quickstart checklist and created a small ticket in the quickstart repo to swap the sample to the REST snippet until PR lands. thanks :thumbsup:
